run_shard_docs: run the shard_docs script to split a large document file into N shards respecting document boundaries
run_shard_docs_num_shards: run shard_docs with --num-shards to split a text file into multiple shard files by document
review_main: review the main function that splits a file into shards using round-robin document distribution
review_output_doc: review the output_doc nested function that writes a document to the correct shard file
refactor_shard_docs: refactor shard_docs to support custom document boundary delimiters instead of empty lines
